scientific_integrity: The result concerns observed Markov-state entropy, not labeled reset-versus-hop actions; distinction made explicit. Infinite proofs analytic, finite checks supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple connected undirected k-regular graphs, k>=2, one reset root; high-girth sharpness uses classical existence of high-girth regular graphs; no optimizer closed form or independently certified numerical bounds. Literature priority incomplete.
title: Sharp regular-graph entropy envelope for random walks with stochastic resetting
